output_md: Meridian Facilities Group, an HVAC company with 120 technicians across three cities, cut overtime hours by 18% in six months using Slatebridge. SLA compliance climbed from 87% to 96%, and dispatchers now rely solely on the company’s board for scheduling. "I used to spend mornings untangling the schedule," says Meridian's ops director. "Now I focus on customers." Ready to streamline your field operations?
